name: FOLLI FOLLIE Commercial Manufacturing And Technical S.A.
summary: FOLLI FOLLIE Commercial Manufacturing And Technical Société Anonyme is a company that focuses on the creation, production, and sale of jewelry, timepieces, and various accessories. Their fashion accessory collection includes items like handbags, wallets, leather goods, pashminas, and sunglasses. The company engages in both direct retail sales and wholesale distribution of its offerings. It also supplies its products wholesale to a selection of international retail partners. In Greece, FOLLI FOLLIE operates its own department stores located in Athens and Thessaloniki, in addition to managing several discount department stores. Beyond its primary categories, the company is also involved in the retail and wholesale trade of branded clothing, footwear, fragrances, cosmetics, and other related merchandise. Established in 1982, FOLLI FOLLIE is headquartered in Athens, Greece, and maintains a network of retail stores across both Greece and Cyprus.
